title: Network CSV rerun Phase 0 contract freeze
summary: Phase 0 contract-freeze prework for Network CSV rerun: documented the current local CSV rerun read model, Local API route boundary, network claim/done protocol shape, and worker result artifact shape before adding distributed CSV rerun behavior.
reason: Network CSV rerun touches coordinator claims, worker result reduction, pending-publish evidence, command journal expectations, and close-readiness. Phase 0 freezes the existing contracts so later phases can make deliberate additive changes.
behavior_before: Local CSV rerun is exposed through /api/rerun/* routes and a desktop_rerun_results.v1 read model with queue_source=csv_rerun and uses_pipeline_start=false. Network workers claim normal queue records through the coordinator /api/claim protocol and report generic DoneRequest fields through /api/done.
behavior_after: No runtime behavior changed. Characterization tests now pin that no Local API network CSV rerun route exists yet and that current network claim/done payloads do not carry CSV rerun row identity fields.
rollback_plan: Revert the Phase 0 characterization assertions and this change packet. No runtime state, media files, queue records, pending-publish manifests, or source files are modified by this change.
notes:
Phase 0 D1-D8 baseline: D1 row claim remains the preferred investigation path; current network claims are normal queue claims only. D2 existing LocalBase/RerunManifests remain local CSV rerun batch/row evidence; no network row-state file exists yet. D3 coordinator reducer or hybrid remains preferred; current workers must not mutate coordinator final destinations or pending-publish manifests for CSV rerun. D4 worker output handoff is undecided for implementation; current network worker result artifact only reports local_worker_result.v1 fields. D5 source path mapping should prefer library_id+relative_path, then coordinator source_path with worker path-map fallback, then blocked row; current ClaimResponse has library_id and relative_path but no CSV row identity. D6 stop/pause/retry/continue are not implemented for network CSV rerun; current local rerun control and network claim/release/done semantics stay separate. D7 worker result extension must be additive and backward-compatible; current DoneRequest and worker result artifact have no rerun batch, row, or CSV path fields. D8 progress rendering is not implemented for network CSV rerun; current rerun results expose queue_source=csv_rerun and uses_pipeline_start=false for local CSV rerun rows only. No PREWORK stop condition was encountered during Phase 0 inspection.
